text:
marco.p: Quick note - the open office has been really rough this month. Background noise + frequent impromptu huddles are triggering sensory overload. I'm requesting a permanent desk move to a quieter zone or approval for hybrid work 3x/week.

jamie.mgr: Sorry to hear that, Marco. We rely on being onsite for a lot of quick syncs. Can you share what "quieter zone" means and whether hybrid would impact sprint commitments?

marco.p: For me quieter zone = corner pods or unused team room. Hybrid wouldn't reduce my output; I'd be online during core overlap and available for async handoffs. Just I'd need fewer surprise in-person drop-ins.

elenor.hr: Thanks for raising this, Marco. This can be handled as an accommodation. If you're comfortable, please submit the ADA intake form so we have formal documentation; we can start temporary measures before docs arrive.

mica.s: I support Marco's request. I noticed he flinches during loud hallway conversations and it affects concentration. We can move small pair sessions to calendared slots instead of pop-ins.

jamie.mgr: That adjustment (scheduled pairing vs pop-ins) seems doable. Concern: some debugging tasks require quick whiteboard time. Could we carve out a daily 1-hr window for live collaboration and keep the rest quieter?

marco.p: A daily 45-60m live window works fine. Outside of that, prefer scheduled meetings or async updates. I can also record key walk-throughs.

facilities-bot: Facilities ticket created: FAC-4021 - "desk relocation request (Marco P)". ETA survey sent to manager.

elenor.hr: Interim plan: 1) move Marco to quieter desk if available within 7 business days, 2) approve noise-cancelling headset immediately, 3) permit hybrid 3x/week for 60 days, 4) daily 1-hr collaboration window, 5) 14/60-day check-ins. I'll draft and post the interim accommodation doc here.

jamie.mgr: I'll prioritize the seat move and block daily collaboration time on his calendar. We'll avoid ad-hoc desk drop-ins.

marco.p: Thank you. I'll submit the intake tonight. Appreciate the quick response.

elenor.hr: HR case opened: HR-8255 - "sensory accomodation: desk move + hybrid (Marco P)". Intake received 1819009000. Assigned: elenor.hr. Confidentiality reminder: share only with stakeholders on the case. :lock:

mica.s: Happy to help with any scheduled pairing and to respect the new cadence.

elenor.hr: Drafted interim accommodation posted - please sign in-thread once you agree so we can close the loop and notify facilities procurement.

marco.p: Signed. :white_check_mark:
